releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 export-classification performance release. v0.1.0-pre.42 builds on the v0.1.0-pre.41 dashboard performance release by pruning unnecessary share-vs-NTFS conflict-classification work for large ACL sets. Conflict classification now avoids building missing-share-gate evidence for identities already covered by the share gate, avoids building share-rights-restriction evidence for identities that cannot produce that conflict, uses cheaper hot-loop evidence updates, and slows high-volume progress heartbeats so long scans do not flood the console every 15 seconds. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
